highlights: Current pages explicitly name Awabot One as formerly Beam and Awabot Pro as formerly BeamPro. This is exact current naming evidence, not proof that every historic Beam-family revision has the present One/Pro specifications.

The company describes manufacturing/integration of telepresence hardware and software, with project deployment and support. Its overview says historical Beam manufacturing was relocated from Palo Alto to Vénissieux following France Relance in 2021; this is company attribution, not an independently inspected full component-origin audit.

Remote human communication and driving, assisted parking, content sharing and fleet/user administration are the core functions. School, hospital, event and business use cases do not establish autonomous healthcare, clinical efficacy or chronological age eligibility.

The Flexi’ Beam article published September 30, 2024 and updated April 10, 2025 advertises rental from 449 EUR/month with Beam/BeamPro,4G connectivity and management/support services. This historical service offer is not a current numeric device purchase quote; tax, term and exact current bundle remain unverified.

HIKU is an artistic performance/project using remotely driven telepresence robots; Flexi’ Beam is a rental offer and Smile Manager is software. They are not additional whole robot models. Supplier deployment totals, market leadership, zero-latency and security claims are not independently verified.
